minimal_fixes: inject numpy: the module uses np without importing it (AH-01)

eligibility.reason: guide 2.1: legacy_reproduction is diagnostic / in-sample reference only

attribution.detail: the first 6 entries are identical. After that the paths separate because the canonical ladder cannot be executed: only its final rung is expressible on intrabar_bracket_v1, so the position closes at a different bar than the legacy partial exits would close it, and the cooldown then admits a different set of entries. The replay does not reach a fixed point for the same reason. This is the recorded blocker showing through, not an unexplained adapter difference.

SD-HASH-01.before_semantics: module references np without importing numpy and cannot be imported
SD-HASH-01.after_semantics: the lab adapter imports numpy explicitly; the original bytes are untouched
SD-HASH-01.reproducer: importing the raw module raises NameError: np
SD-HASH-01.expected_effect: none on decisions; the alpha simply becomes runnable

SD-HASH-02.before_semantics: entry booked at the signal close, protective levels derived from it
SD-HASH-02.after_semantics: close decision then next-open fill; levels derived from the actual fill price
SD-HASH-02.expected_effect: shifts every entry by one bar and re-prices SL/TP

SD-HASH-03.before_semantics: an if/elif chain fills at most one TP stage per bar and gates the final TP on both partials
SD-HASH-03.after_semantics: an explicit ordered ladder evaluates every level a bar actually crossed, in price order
SD-HASH-03.expected_effect: more complete exits on wide bars; the legacy stage-lock path is retained as legacy_reproduction

SD-HASH-04.before_semantics: realized-only equity inside the alpha, used as if it were the account
SD-HASH-04.after_semantics: the engine ledger owns equity; the legacy column is kept as a labelled diagnostic
SD-HASH-04.expected_effect: removes a mark-to-market blind spot from any objective

attribution_rule: every difference must map to a semantic delta. A legacy entry that falls inside the canonical warmup window is attributed to the readiness repairs; an unattributed difference is a defect in the adapter, not a result.
claim_boundary: the legacy tier is diagnostic and in-sample only. Neither side is a performance claim, and a canonical result is never compared against a legacy number as if they were arms.
